The '''2026 World Championship Consolation''' was the Sunday constructed consolation event at the [[2026 World Championship]] in Bloomington, Minnesota, on 25 October 2026.<ref name="sched">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86982 2026 World Championship Schedule of Events], Star Wars CCG Players Committee forum, Chris Schoenthal (imrahil327) (14 September 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114004451/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86982.html Internet Archive].</ref> Twenty-seven players entered. [[Patrick Johnson]] won undefeated. [[Carson Stockman]], [[Sam Tashima]] and [[AJ Hatoum]] finished second, third and fourth.<ref name="conso">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=87038 Consolation Tournament Pairings], Star Wars CCG Players Committee forum, Chris Schoenthal (imrahil327) (25 October 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114010712/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t87038.html Internet Archive].</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Hyatt Regency Bloomington by Mall of America, Bloomington, Minnesota
* '''Date:''' 25 October 2026 (registration 10:00 a.m., start 10:30 a.m.)<ref name="sched" />
* '''Structure:''' six Swiss games, strength of schedule<ref name="sched" />
* '''Players:''' 27<ref name="conso" />
* '''Entry:''' $10, included in the Worlds weekend pass<ref name="sched" />
* '''Decklists:''' not required<ref name="sched" />
